title: ‘Big John’ Fisher’s Australian takeaway: get the right visa next time
summary: British social media star sent back by border force after apparently arriving on tourist paperwork but with several appearances scheduled British social media personality “Big John” Fisher has cut short a tour and appearances in Australia after saying he was detained by immigration officers for arriving on the wrong visa. Fisher, who is famous for his love of Chinese takeaway and reviews of fast food and has almost 700,000 followers on Instagram, said he was held for four hours by Australian Border Force officers after arriving in Perth on Tuesday.
